[Description of the TV series "José Rizal"] "José Rizal" is a Philippine television series that aired on GMA Network from November 14, 2014 to March 6, 2015 with a total of 20 episodes. It was replaced by "More Than Words" in its timeslot. In March 2016, the series was released on DVD by GMA Records Home Video. The series is streaming on YouTube. The premise of the series is as follows: José Rizal needed to leave his family to fulfill his studies and career abroad, while also suffering from homesickness, and enduring a long-distance relationship with the woman he loved. He comes back home and uses the knowledge and skills he learned abroad to help improve the lives of his family and countrymen.
